_comment: Each universe's world: where the wormhole's mouth stands in it and its static objects, in that universe's world coordinates (metres, z up, the floor at z = 0). Mouths: x, y of the throat's centre on the floor and its turn in degrees (anticlockwise seen from above): a point at chart position c (WormholeSpace's) is at world turn(c) + (x, y, 0). Placing (placing.gd) moves a mouth; the reset puts both back here. Spheres: x, y, z, radius. Pillars: x, y, radius, height. Boxes: x, y, z, half size. Universe A has spheres_A and pillars_A, universe B has spheres_B and boxes_B. The renderer gives each sphere its own colour, in this order, A's then B's (Renderer.SPHERE_COLORS).
